name: Unshaping Orb
description: Downgrades a map on the Atlas
directions: Right click this item then left click a shaped map on the atlas to downgrade it. You can then earn the Shaper's Orb again to reshape another map afterwards.
consoleDirections: X to use, then A on a shaped map on the atlas to downgrade it. You can then earn the Shaper's Orb again to reshape another map afterwards.
